images.caption: Rodolfo Rivarola Street, near downtown Buenos Aires. The Beaux-Arts buildings lining the street were designed by Petersen, Thiele & Cruz, and built by GEOPÉ in 1924-25.The street served as a filming location for a number of Argentine films, including Emilio Alfaro's 1985 political drama There Are Some Guys Downstairs and Rodolfo Pagliere's The Day Maradona Met Gardel (1996).
images.alt: Rodolfo Rivarola Street, near downtown Buenos Aires. The Beaux-Arts buildings lining the street were designed by Petersen, Thiele & Cruz, and built by GEOPÉ in 1924-25.The street served as a filming location for a number of Argentine films, including Emilio Alfaro's 1985 political drama There Are Some Guys Downstairs and Rodolfo Pagliere's The Day Maradona Met Gardel (1996).
